queries_run: Sezzle SEZL business model shift subscription platform 2026
Sezzle distribution channel merchant go-to-market change 2026

findings.claim: Q1 2026 活躍訂閱用戶 714,000，年增 48.4%；訂閱＋隨選月付用戶合計 887,000，年增 34.8%；季均購買頻率 7.1 次（前年 6.1 次）。搜尋摘要稱此為由單次 BNPL 交易轉向訂閱式經常性收費關係，並以 Sezzle Anywhere 虛擬卡擴大可用商家範圍。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance / Zacks 摘要：Sezzle Recasts BNPL Model With Subscriptions Sezzle Anywhere And Eased Rules

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要稱 Sezzle 商家開發由量取向轉為優先大型企業商家；Q2 2026 新增企業商家含 Poshmark、Gymshark、Debenhams、Brookshire's、RockAuto。
findings.source: TradingView/Zacks：SEZL's Merchant Acquisition Strategy Vital for Its Growth Trajectory；Investing.com：Sezzle Q2 2026 slides

findings.claim: FY2025 Q4 財報（發布日 2026-02-25）：新增 134,000 名隨選月付與訂閱用戶，總數 918,000；2026 計畫包含更高信用額度的長期借貸與更廣商家接受度。
findings.source: PYMNTS：Sezzle GMV Surges as Super App Plans Advance
findings.excerpt: Sezzle also added 134,000 new Monthly On-Demand and Subscribers during the quarter, bringing the total to 918,000.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 前兩條 as_of 為依來源季度推估的約略日（搜尋摘要未給確切發布日），excerpt 因搜尋結果僅為改寫摘要故填 null。用戶數口徑 918,000（Q4 2025）與 887,000（Q1 2026）不同期，未交叉核對。
